notes: Two immutable declared profiles, four explicit version/instance destinations and client-keyed local/shared synthetic maps.
Every reply checks HTTP, client/version/instance binding and all seven declared profile fields.
Previous interruptions and unknowns survive later good reads within a run.
Supplied JSON checks never write stores; source counters distinguish samples, injected faults and stored-profile reads.
Mode changes and Reset start separate untested runs, not a migration or repair.
Text-node rendering; no external assets, network APIs or browser persistence.

sequence.scope: Node built-in tests of model, script export and static page guards. The VM export check is not a browser or DOM test.

Final acceptance ran on a visible, fresh, worker-owned forceNew file page with native Tab/arrows/Enter, ordinary clicks, fault/invalid-data checks and full Reset. Zero HTTP requests, page errors, console errors or CSP violations during acceptance. The compact equivalent UI protocol was inlined in the real browser tool; no CommonJS loader or Node mock was used. Historical hidden-page attempts are excluded.

limits: Both versions understand profile schema 1 by assumption; no serializer-compatibility result.
